payload.name: Hydroball
payload.description: a conal AoE directed to the main target. Inflicts Silence if hit. Players can interact with the grate when it is bubbling to prevent an add from spawning. To this extent, ranged DPS can position themselves to be in range to attack, while still able to quickly interact with the grates when they bubble. Should adds spawn, try to keep their numbers down to prevent the tank from being overwhelmed. If a caster is targeted by the adds, they should run to the tank so that the tank can remove hate while staying by the boss. In most runs, the grates and the adds they spawn are generally ignored, and all damage is focused on the boss.
